reference.title: Dumbbell High Pull
reference.listing: Animated GIF; data sheet: body part Shoulders, equipment Dumbbell, exercise type Strength

breathing.pattern: Breathe in and brace in the hang, breathe out sharply through the drive and pull, breathe in as you lower back to the hang.
breathing.cadence: Fast up (about 0.6 s), controlled down (about 1.2 s)

prescription.effort: Every rep fast; stop the set when the speed drops
prescription.tempo: Explosive up, controlled down, reset in the hang
prescription.load: User-chosen dumbbells; light to moderate. With a barbell, peak power in the hang high pull was highest at about 45% of the hang power clean 1RM (Suchomel 2015)
prescription.progression: Add speed first, then load; progress to the dumbbell hang clean or snatch

cues.text: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, palms facing you. Push the hips back and bend the knees a little until the dumbbells are just above the knees; flat back, shoulders over the dumbbells.
Jump the hips forward: drive hard through the feet, straighten the hips and knees and shrug.
Let the momentum carry the dumbbells up; pull the elbows high and out to about shoulder height, dumbbells close to the chest.
Lower the dumbbells under control and hinge back into the hang.
Reset the flat back and brace before the next rep.

mistakes.mistake: Pulling with the arms first (a slow upright row)
mistakes.fix: Let the hip drive start the dumbbells moving; the arms only finish the pull.
Finish tall, hips straight but not pushed forward past the feet.

mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back in the hang
mistakes.fix: Hinge from the hips, chest up, dumbbells close to the thighs.
Lead with the elbows; keep them above the hands at the top.

kinematics.norm: Dumbbells just above the knees: hips back, knees slightly bent, trunk inclined forward with a flat back (clinical opinion)
From the hinge to fully upright in the drive; the high pull produced more peak power and velocity than the hang clean (Suchomel 2014)
About 20-30 degrees in the hang, nearly straight at the end of the drive (clinical opinion)
Elbows up and out to about shoulder height, above the hands (clinical opinion)
Explosive drive; peak velocity in the hang high pull was highest with the lightest load tested, 30% of 1RM (Suchomel 2015)

sources.title: GymVisual #566613, Dumbbell High Pull, animated GIF (movement reference)
Suchomel, Wright, Kernozek and Kline 2014, kinetic comparison of the power development between power clean variations (J Strength Cond Res 28(2):350-360)
Suchomel, Beckham and Wright 2015, effect of various loads on the force-time characteristics of the hang high pull (J Strength Cond Res 29(5):1295-1301)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, a pinching feeling in the front or top of the shoulder, numbness or tingling occurs.
The dumbbell load is user-chosen: pick a weight you can control for every rep with good form.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
The studies used a barbell; dumbbell loads and timing are clinical opinion.
Keep the elbows no higher than about shoulder height if raising the arms with internal rotation causes a pinch in the shoulder.
modify: Shoulder pinch at the top: stop the elbows below shoulder height, or do a dumbbell jump shrug (no arm pull).
Low-back discomfort: start from a higher hang (mid-thigh) with less hinge.
regressions: Dumbbell jump shrug or plain shrug.
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift to learn the hang position.
Slow dumbbell upright row to shoulder height.

muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Shrug the shoulders up hard at the end of the hip drive and keep pulling as the elbows rise.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Shrug the shoulders up hard at the end of the hip drive and keep pulling as the elbows rise.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_r: Lifts the elbows high and out to the sides, to about shoulder height.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_l: Lifts the elbows high and out to the sides, to about shoulder height.
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Drives the explosive hip extension from the hang; most of the power comes from the hips and knees (clinical opinion; the high pull is a clean pulling derivative, Suchomel 2014).
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Drives the explosive hip extension from the hang; most of the power comes from the hips and knees (clinical opinion; the high pull is a clean pulling derivative, Suchomel 2014).
muscleNotes.post_deltoid_r: Pulls the elbows up and back at the top.
muscleNotes.post_deltoid_l: Pulls the elbows up and back at the top.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Load in the hang (hinge) and extend the hips.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Load in the hang (hinge) and extend the hips.
muscleNotes.quads_r: Straighten the knees in the drive.
muscleNotes.quads_l: Straighten the knees in the drive.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_r: Hold the shoulder blades back as the elbows rise.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_l: Hold the shoulder blades back as the elbows rise.
muscleNotes.biceps_r: Bend the elbows as the dumbbells travel up.
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Bend the elbows as the dumbbells travel up.
muscleNotes.calves_r: Finish the drive; many lifters rise onto the balls of the feet (this animation keeps the feet flat).
muscleNotes.calves_l: Finish the drive; many lifters rise onto the balls of the feet (this animation keeps the feet flat).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Keep the back flat in the hang and as the hips drive through.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Keep the back flat in the hang and as the hips drive through.
muscleNotes.core: Braces the trunk so the hip drive passes into the arms.
